metadata.description: Short prefix used for Azure resource names. Use lowercase letters and numbers only.
Environment label appended to resource names.
Primary deployment location.
Optional model override. Leave empty to use the provider default.
Deploy the API and access-executor Container Apps (the workflow sets this after migrations succeed).
Deploy the migration Container Apps Job with containerImage (the workflow runs it before deploying the apps).

Startup and liveness probes on the executor's own /health (ACCESS_WORKER_METRICS_PORT), so a hung worker is restarted. Needs an image whose worker serves that endpoint (src/access_job_worker.py starting src.metrics.start_worker_metrics_server).
Gunicorn workers per API replica (GUNICORN_WORKERS).
SQLAlchemy pool size per process (DB_POOL_SIZE).
SQLAlchemy overflow connections per process (DB_MAX_OVERFLOW).
Login role the API and the executor use: DML only on the application tables, created and granted by the migration job. The server admin is used by migrations alone.
PostgreSQL high-availability mode. ZoneRedundant/SameZone require the GeneralPurpose or MemoryOptimized tier (not Burstable).
Standby availability zone used when postgresHighAvailabilityMode is ZoneRedundant (must differ from the primary zone 1).
Enable geo-redundant PostgreSQL backups for cross-region disaster recovery.
Standard or Premium: queued access jobs, link sessions and MFA state live in Redis, and Basic is a single node without replication or an SLA.

Pass the audit-hmac-key-previous Key Vault secret as AUDIT_HMAC_KEY_PREVIOUS while the audit key is being rotated (docs/RUNBOOK.md). The workflow sets it while the GitHub variable AZURE_AUDIT_HMAC_KEY_ROTATING is true.
SMTP server for password-reset mail. Empty: no reset mail is sent.
SMTP port (587 for STARTTLS).
SMTP login user. Empty: no login.
From address of password-reset mail. Required with smtpHost.
The app page reset emails link to, e.g. https://app.example.com/reset?token={token}. Empty: the email carries the one-time code.
Pass the smtp-password Key Vault secret as SMTP_PASSWORD.

Administrator the API creates at startup when no account holds this username or email (with bootstrapUserEmail and the bootstrap-user-password secret). Production has self-registration off, so this is how the first account is made.
Email of the bootstrap administrator.
Pass the bootstrap-user-password Key Vault secret as BOOTSTRAP_USER_PASSWORD. Needs bootstrapUserUsername and bootstrapUserEmail.
Address space of the virtual network.
Subnet of the Container Apps environment (workload profiles; /27 minimum, /23 leaves room to scale).
Subnet delegated to PostgreSQL Flexible Server.
Subnet for private endpoints (Redis).
Spread the Container Apps environment across availability zones (run minReplicas >= 2 to benefit).

Peers the API trusts to set X-Forwarded-For / X-Forwarded-Proto (gunicorn FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS). The API is reachable only through the environment ingress, whose proxies use private addresses; without this the HTTPS redirect loops and every client shares the ingress address for rate limiting.
Run Chromium with its sandbox (BROWSER_CHROMIUM_SANDBOX). If the executor logs "No usable sandbox" on this platform, set false; see docs/AZURE_DEPLOYMENT.md for the trade-off.
Object ID of the service principal the deployment workflow signs in as. It gets Key Vault Secrets Officer on this vault to write the runtime secrets. Empty skips the assignment.
Suffix of the Key Vault name. A deleted vault keeps its name for the soft-delete retention period: recover it (az keyvault recover) or change this to create a new one.
